description: Submits previously created SMI deep report drafts (Draft status only) for processing. A batch of up to 25 ids is processed immediately and the result lists accepted and rejected ids. A larger batch runs as a background job that the server waits on for a few seconds, then returns the same accepted and rejected ids plus the jobId. If the result has status queued, the job is still running or could not be read: call smi_get_job with its jobId and do not resubmit the ids. If the job failed, SMI does not say whether any id was submitted: check each id with smi_check_order_complete before resubmitting. SMI notifies the user when each deep report is released; smi_check_order_complete reads the status of a single record.
name: smi_submit_deep_reports
title: Submit Deep Reports
